title: Version cutover ops checklist and customer ambassador upgrade program
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Coordinate a staged version cutover for the model-serving API and related SDKs with a strong cross-functional ops checklist and a customer ambassador upgrade program. Objective: achieve predictable, low-friction migrations for customers (especially enterprise and Dedicated users) while protecting SLAs. This ticket scopes the launch coordination items: release notes sequencing, support runbooks, rollback windows, observability gating, comms timeline, and a recruited ambassador cohort for early adopter migrations.
tasks: Finalize cutover ops checklist with Eng: fallback model variants, traffic splitting, canary thresholds, and automatic rollback triggers
Create staged release notes and per-audience summaries (developers, platform engineers, enterprise admins)
Publish migration CLI and SDK patch notes; coordinate semantic version bump with SDK owners
Assemble support runbooks and post-migration validation checks for CS and SRE
Set up monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds (latency, error rate, perf regressions)
Recruit 6 customer ambassadors (mix of startups and enterprise) and schedule migration workshops
Coordinate legal/security approval for private deployment compatibility notes
Design a self-serve compatibility checker for customers to run against their call patterns
Prepare rollback playbook and schedule a blackout window for destructive changes
Plan training and playbook handoff sessions for Solutions Engineering and Sales
discussion: 2025-02-12 - Maya T.: Kickoff with Eng and Docs. Agree to two-week canary followed by 4-week gradual ramp for hosted customers.
2025-02-18 - Rahul Patel (Eng): Eng will expose a per-customer rollout flag and a telemetry tag for degraded responses. Need additional ETA on SDK bump.
2025-02-25 - Zoe Lin (Docs): Working draft of migration guide posted to Drive. Will create 1-click note templates for emails.
2025-02-27 - Liam O'C.: Draft comms cadence: announcement -> migration window open -> reminder -> migration complete -> post-mortem. Shared with growth for messaging alignment.
2025-02-28 - Security: Confirmed no new data residency changes; recommended note about KMS key rotations in private deployments.
decisions: Use model-variant fallback (compatible-1) as default during ramp to avoid hard errors
Canary gating will require <1% error-rate delta and <10% latency P95 regression to proceed from canary to ramp
Ambassador program will target customers with >$5k monthly usage or dedicated instances for prioritized scheduling
Release notes will include a 'what changed' diff, migration steps, CLI commands, and a rollback section
rollout_timeline: 2025-03-10: Public announcement of planned deprecation + Migration guide live
2025-03-17 to 2025-03-31: Ambassador cohort migrations (scheduled workshops and runbooks)
2025-04-01 to 2025-04-14: Hosted canary window (select traffic routes, monitor gating metrics)
2025-04-15: Begin gradual ramp to 25% traffic for two weeks
2025-05-01: 100% traffic target for non-dedicated customers if no regressions
2025-05-15: Forced-deprecation start for legacy variant (customer-visible notices continue)
comms_plan: Tiered comms: 1) Pre-announcement blog and changelog entry for general audience. 2) Targeted emails + in-console banners for active customers with migration instructions. 3) Dedicated success plans and weekly syncs for ambassador cohort. 4) Support playbook and canned responses for CS/SRE. 5) Post-migration summary and opt-in feedback survey.
migration_playbook: Step-by-step migration guide: (1) Run compatibility checker against representative traces. (2) Test under 'staging' account with SDK bump. (3) Switch a small percentage of traffic to new variant with telemetry tag. (4) Monitor P50/P95 latency, error-rate delta, and token costs. (5) If gating thresholds exceeded, trigger automatic rollback and open incident with runbook. (6) After 2 full weeks of stable metrics, proceed to next ramp stage.
acceptance_criteria: Ops checklist approved by Eng, SRE, and Security
Migration CLI and SDK patch published and version-tagged
Ambassador cohort completed migrations with documented playbook updates
Monitoring dashboards and alerting in place for all rollout stages
Customer-facing docs and release notes published and linked in console
